rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent low sports volume rather than a fragmented object. Across all four views, the mass retains a continuous hall datum with a shallow notch/court condition on one side, and the roof profile remains legible as a single governing section rather than disconnected pieces. The parcel response is acceptable: the mass sits coherently within the boundary and does not merely fill the box. The blue access edge is acknowledged only weakly, however—the form does not strongly open or carve a public threshold toward the verified frontage, so the access relation is present but underdeveloped. Programmatically, the visible section and elongated hall-like body plausibly support a compact gymnasium, especially the folded roof logic and subordinate entry/service articulation. It is not a perfect clear-span hall signal, but it does not violate the gym typology.
